title: SaturQ: Saturation-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2607.12266v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mixed-precision quantization assigns each module of a language model its own precision format, such as NVFP4, FP8, or BF16, to minimize damage within a memory budget. Most allocators predict the damage of a configuration by summing per-unit sensitivities measured in unquantized networks. But the sensitivity of a unit \textit{saturates} as more units are quantized, so the sum overprices the heavily quantized configurations that tight budgets require. Assuming only that damage accumulates by an associative, increasing, continuous rule restricts it to the form $g\bigl(\sum_i b_i\bigr)$, with summed sensitivities as the case of linear $g$. We propose SaturQ, which uses a concave $g$, fits the per-unit parameters $b_i$ from a single Aumann--Shapley path integral, and allocates formats with a linear program. translated_title: SaturQ：饱和感知的混合精度量化
translated_abstract: 混合精度量化为语言模型的每个模块分配各自的精度格式（如NVFP4、FP8或BF16），以在内存预算内最小化量化损伤。大多数分配方法通过累加在未量化网络中测得的各单元敏感度来预测某个配置的损伤。但随着更多单元被量化，单个单元的敏感度会趋于饱和，因此简单求和会高估紧预算下所需的高量化程度配置的损伤。仅假设损伤按可结合、递增、连续的规则累积，即可将损伤形式限定为 g(∑_i b_i)，其中敏感度求和是线性 g 的特例。我们提出SaturQ，它采用凹函数形式的 g，通过单次Aumann–Shapley路径积分拟合各单元参数 b_i，并用线性规划分配精度格式。在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，在4.2–6.0有效比特下，SaturQ相比ModelOpt AutoQuantize将对BF16的KL散度降低了11–23%，……
tldr: SaturQ用凹形累积函数修正传统敏感度简单求和导致的饱和高估问题，通过单次Aumann–Shapley路径积分拟合参数并用线性规划分配精度，在Qwen3-30B-A3B上将KL散度较ModelOpt AutoQuantize降低11–23%。
en_tdlr: SaturQ addresses sensitivity saturation in mixed-precision quantization by modeling damage with a concave accumulation function, fitting per-unit parameters via a single Aumann–Shapley path integral, and allocating formats through linear programming, reducing KL divergence by 11–23% over ModelOpt AutoQuantize on Qwen3-30B-A3B.
